questions.justification: Needs the identity cos2A+cos2B+cos2C=-1-4cosAcosBcosC and the cosAcosBcosC<=1/8 bound to know the triangle is equilateral, then four statements each to be checked (dot product, perimeter, trig identity, area) in a 'NOT correct' format. Nearest anchor 2021-P1-Q18 (L2) plus statement checks.
